title: Executive Summary Platform - Complete Overview
author: Platform Team
summary: Comprehensive overview of the Executive Summary Platform - your complete guide to creating beautiful, data-driven executive summaries and organization dashboards.
overview: Welcome to the Executive Summary Platform knowledge base! This modern React application enables you to create stunning executive summaries, manage organizations, and build custom templates with a metadata-driven architecture.
whatYouWillLearn: Core platform components (Viewer, CMS Admin, Template Builder)
How the metadata-driven rendering system works
Available render types and when to use them
How to create and edit executive summaries
How to build custom templates visually
Expression syntax for rich text formatting
keyPoints: Dynamic rendering system - content adapts based on metadata patterns
Multi-column layouts - responsive 1-4 column grid system
Chart visualizations - Pie, Bar, Line, and Radial charts with Recharts
Template Builder - visual drag-and-drop template creation
Expression Engine - rich text formatting with custom syntax
Unified architecture - Organizations and Summaries share the same rendering engine
quickStart: Open the main application at http://localhost:5173 to view published summaries and organizations. Access the CMS Admin to create and edit content. Use the Template Builder to create custom summary templates.

steps.title: Platform Components
steps.description: The platform consists of three main components: Frontend Viewer (React + Vite), CMS Admin (Editor), and Template Builder
steps.instructions:
Frontend Viewer - Public-facing display of executive summaries and organization dashboards
CMS Admin - Content editor with full CRUD operations
Template Builder - Visual template creation tool

steps.title: Architecture Components
steps.description: Backend API (Node.js + Express) provides CRUD operations, file management, and image uploads. Data is stored as JSON files.
steps.instructions:
The backend serves:
- CRUD operations for summaries, templates, uploads
- File system management
- Image upload handling
- JSON data storage in src/data/summaries/*.json and cms-admin/src/templates/*.json
steps.expectedOutcome: Understanding how data flows through the system

steps.title: Core Concepts
steps.description: Learn the metadata-driven architecture where every content section uses metadata to define its structure and rendering
steps.instructions:
Every section follows this pattern:
{
  "sectionName": ["actual", "data"],
  "_sectionName_type": "listNoTitle",
  "_sectionName_fields": { /* field definitions */ },
  "_sectionName_columnSpan": 2,
  "_enabled_sectionName": true,
  "_completed_sectionName": false
}

steps.title: Render Factory Pattern
steps.description: The RenderFactory routes data to appropriate renderers based on type
steps.instructions:
Available renderers:
- TextRenderer (text, textarea)
- NumberRenderer (number)
- ListRenderer (list, listNoTitle)
- NestedCardsRenderer (nestedCards)
- ChartRenderer (pieChart, barChart, lineChart, radialChart)
- HorizontalRuleRenderer (hr)
- CodeBlockRenderer (codeBlock)
- QuoteRenderer (quote)

steps.title: Key Features
steps.instructions:
Dynamic Rendering - Content sections adapt based on metadata
Multi-Column Layouts - Responsive grid system (1-4 columns)
Chart Visualizations - Beautiful data viz with Recharts
Template Builder - Visual template creation
Expression Engine - Rich text formatting
Live Preview - Real-time preview while editing

bestPractices.title: Use Metadata-Driven Approach
bestPractices.description: Always define render types and field schemas to ensure consistent rendering
bestPractices.reason: Enables dynamic rendering without code changes

bestPractices.title: Plan Your Layouts
bestPractices.description: Sketch column spans before implementing multi-column layouts
bestPractices.reason: Prevents alignment issues and ensures responsive design

bestPractices.title: Test Expressions
bestPractices.description: Use the Expression Editor to preview formatting before deploying
